name: coding-cicd-hardening
description: Secure coding and CI/CD baseline with a standard-library workflow linter and a CycloneDX 1.7 and SPDX 2.3 SBOM generator.

interface.shortDescription: Harden workflows, pin the supply chain, ship SBOMs.
interface.longDescription: Applies a checked baseline to a repository: actions pinned to full commit SHAs, OIDC in place of static cloud keys, empty default token permissions, no credential persistence, no pull_request_target, secret scanning, SAST, dependency review, grouped Dependabot updates, tests that cannot reach production by default, and CycloneDX 1.7 plus SPDX 2.3 SBOMs. Ships a workflow linter and an SBOM generator that need only the Python standard library.
defaultPrompt: Use $secure-coding-cicd to audit this repository's workflows and bring them up to the hardened baseline.
